output:
function CalculateGrade(marks: integer): string;
begin
  if marks >= 90 then
    Result := 'A'
  else if marks >= 80 then
    Result := 'B'
  else if marks >= 70 then
    Result := 'C'
  else if marks >= 60 then
    Result := 'D'
  else if marks >= 50 then
    Result := 'E'
  else
    Result := 'F';
end;

output:
function CheckPower(n, k: integer): boolean;
begin
  if n = 1 then
    Result := true
  else if n < k then
    Result := false
  else if n mod k = 0 then
    Result := CheckPower(n div k, k)
  else
    Result := false;
end;
